key%20is%20a%20gold%20color%20laced%20with%20reddish%20amber%20hues%20and%20nearly%20copper%20in%20tone.%20This%20Kentucky%20whiskey%20liquor%20features%20aromatic%20notes%20of%20subtle%20vanilla%2C%20raisins%2C%20maple%20syrup%20and%20toasted%20nuts%20that%20lead%20to%20flavors%20of%20vanilla%2C%20ripe%20fruit%2C%20maple%20syrup%2C%20toast%20and%20bitter%20chocolate%20followed%20by%20a%20clean%20and%20lingering%20sweetness%20with%20a%20hint%20of%20Madeira%20that%20slowly%20fades.%20Every%20barrel%20is%20tasted%20throughout%20each%20stage%20of%20the%20aging%20process%20to%20ensure%20it%20meets%20perfectionist%20standards.%20Enjoy%20it%20neat%20in%20a%20bourbon%20glass%2C%20chilled%2C%20with%20just%20a%20splash%20of%20water%20or%20in%20alcohol%20drinks%20like%20an%20Old%20Fashioned.%20With%20Angel%E2%80%99s%20Envy%2C%20Heaven%20can%20wait.%20Please%20Drink%20Responsibly.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F680626e02a16bc3b0b3b6c90%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F680626e02a16bc3b0b3b6c90%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F680626e02a16bc3b0b3b6c90%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F680626e02a16bc3b0b3b6c90%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F680626e02a16bc3b0b3b6c90%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%5D%7D%2C%22size%22%3A%7B%22measure%22%3A%22ml%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A%22750%22%7D%2C%22subtitle%22%3Anull%2C%22views%22%3A%5B%22spirits%22%5D%2C%22basic_category%22%3A%5B%22bourbon%22%2C%22whiskey%22%5D%2C%22properties%22%3A%7B%22product_views%22%3A%5B%22spirits%22%5D%2C%22product_basic_categories%22%3A%5B%22bourbon%22%2C%22whiskey%22%5D%2C%22basic_category%22%3A%22Spirits%22%2C%22brands%22%3A%5B%22Angel's%20Envy%22%5D%2C%22country%22%3A%
